title: Partial Canary Compromise & Selective Revocation — four compromise units, six verdicts, six-step recomputation

source.source_reference: Shawn's explicit teaching, main chat, 2026-10-10. Filed same-evening per his standing law: his word IS the verification (Verification Law); filed immediately, not queued.

intelligence.essence: When a canary family is compromised, you don't burn the whole evaluation — you revoke exactly what the compromise touches. Four compromise units (single canary, family, exposure path, verification binding) and six verdicts (from CLEAN to COMPROMISED-for-blind-use to RETIRED) let the system quarantine surgically. The governing principle: 'Evidence immutable, independence revocable, qualifications recomputable.' The evidence of what happened never changes; the independence claims get re-examined; every qualification that depended on the compromised piece is recomputed from what's still clean. Standing application (2026-10-10): cold-successor and causal claims = SUSPENDED; two root receipts = COMPROMISED for blind use; the T11 family = RETIRED; 218 exposed files = regression-only.

human_view.meaning: If one test is compromised, only that test's proof dies — not everything. The facts of what happened are frozen; what we claim they prove gets re-examined; every verdict built on the bad piece is recomputed.
human_view.why_it_matters: Turns contamination from a catastrophe into a surgery. Without it, one leak either destroys all trust or gets ignored — both are wrong.

simple_view.meaning: If one test is compromised, only that test's proof dies — not everything. The facts of what happened are frozen; what we claim they prove gets re-examined; every verdict built on the bad piece is recomputed.

naya_view.directive: On compromise detection: classify the unit (canary/family/path/binding), assign the verdict, freeze the evidence, revoke the independence claims it supported, and recompute every downstream qualification in six steps. Never silently keep a compromised qualification alive; never nuke a clean one.

ai_view.specification: revoke(compromise_unit) → verdict ∈ 6 states; qualifications Q depending on the unit are recomputed over the clean remainder. Evidence log is append-only; independence claims are the revocable layer.
ai_view.directive: Follow as written. This is law, not guidance.

machine_view.spec_only: Spec-only by design; live KNOW/LAW/ACT wiring parked for the Human Director's word. No production claim.

intelligence.uncertainty: Verdict thresholds and the six recomputation steps' ordering are implementer-defined; the principle (immutable evidence, revocable independence, recomputable qualifications) is fixed.
intelligence.applicability: Every seat that handles contamination or cites qualifications built on evaluated evidence.
intelligence.falsifier: Falsified if a compromised qualification remains cited as valid, or a clean qualification is revoked without cause.
intelligence.measurement_contract: Track revocation events and recomputation completeness; every downstream qualification must resolve to a fresh verdict.
intelligence.successor_effect: A cold successor finding a compromised canary performs the surgery itself: evidence frozen, independence revoked, qualifications recomputed — no panic, no cover-up.
